flaws.note: The search route builds a $where JavaScript expression with the query string inside a quote; a single quote breaks out and runs arbitrary JavaScript against every document, scope included. The companies route next to it is the safe decoy ($regex with escaping).
Sign-up spreads the whole body into User.create, so role: 'admin' in the request makes an admin; the pick() helper exists and is used in contacts but not here.
Unknown errors return message and stack to the client unless NODE_ENV is test, so production (NODE_ENV=production) leaks stack traces and internal paths.
